header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.arabic_text: إِلَّا تَنَاسَخَتْ، حَتَّي تَكُونَ آخِرُ عَاقِبَتِهَا مُلْكاً، فَسَتَخْبُرُونَ وَتُجَرِّبُونَ اْلاَُمَرَاءَ بَعْدَنَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب الدنيا سجن للمؤمن وجنة للكافر رقم:٧٤٣٥
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Khalid ibn Umair Adawi (RA) says, “Once Hazrat Utbah ibn Ghazwan (RA) delivered a sermon among us. (He was the governor of Basrah.) After praising and glorifying Allah, he said, “Indeed! The world has announced its own passing away, and is hastening off, turning its back. Like the drink that remains in a vessel, only a little of the worldly life remains, and a person sips up that remaining drink. You are about to move from the world to an everlasting, imperishable home; so go to that home taking the best of what you have (good deeds)! “If a stone is thrown from the edge of Jahannam, even if it keeps falling into Jahannam for seventy years, that stone cannot reach its bottom. By Allah! Even this (so vast) Jahannam will one day be filled with people’. Does this news not astonish you? “Moreover, we have been told that the distance between the two sides of the gate of Jannah is a distance of forty years, and that one day even this so wide gate will be filled by the crowding of the people of Jannah. We were seven people with the Prophet ﷺ, and I was one of them; we got only leaves to eat, and because of continually eating leaves our jaws were all wounded.
